subject: English
question_text: Write a letter to your friend telling him/her about how
stimulus: you have enjoyed in the picnic recently. 10
guide_solution: Letter writing 27/1, Kalishankarpur, Kushtia 10 September, 2015 Dear Nabil, 128 How are you? First of all take my cordial love. You will be glad to know that last 5 September, 2015 we went on a picnic to the Shat Gambuj Mosque in Bagerhat. Before we started our journey from Kushtia town by bus, we had done the preparatory chores the previous day We also took with us other necessary things. The bus took us to the place without difficulties. We reached there before the expected time. Reaching there, we visited around the Shat Gambuj Mosque. As we took with us cooked food, we did not have to cook. Actually, I enjoyed it very much. I was surprised to see the big and beautiful building of the mosque. The mosque is beautifully decorated. The surrounding scenery is also charming. Since I was the first boy of my class, all the students selected me as their leader. As a leader, I led the function nicely. However, after having fun and amusement for more five hours, we returned to our home in the evening. The picnic has marked a deep impression on my mind and relieved me of the monotony of daily life. I believe, this type of amusement which really freshens our mind and invigorates our spirit. No more body. Yours ever Rony
